title: Finite-presentation section calculus on the qcqs pro-etale site
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $V\to X$ be an object of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site] with $V$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Use the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. For every small filtered diagram of abelian sheaves $(F_i)$ on $V_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], the canonical map $\varinjlim_i F_i(V)\to(\varinjlim_i F_i)(V)$ is bijective. Let $A$ be any sheaf of commutative rings on $V_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and let $P$ be an $A$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] which is pro-etale locally the cokernel of $A^m\to A^n$, with $m,n$ finite nonnegative integers. For every small filtered diagram of $A$-module sheaves $(N_i)$ the canonical map $\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}_A(P,N_i)\to\operatorname{Hom}_A(P,\varinjlim_iN_i)$ is bijective. The maps are induced by the given colimit coprojections; thus equality of two representatives holds at a common later stage. Colimits are sheaf colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: Mathlib quasi-compact covering extraction gives a finite affine refinement of every covering of a qcqs object of the pro-etale site. The source-library ProEt instance provides pullbacks and preservation by the forgetful functor to schemes. Quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism permanence in Mathlib makes their overlaps qcqs.

Realize each abelian sheaf colimit as the sheafification of the presheaf colimit, using Sheaf.isColimitSheafifyCocone. The sheafification unit is locally injective and locally surjective. Concrete filtered colimit representative lemmas then give local lifts to stages and local eventual equalities. All identifications respect the given cocone coprojections.

Refine local equality covers to finite affine covers. Filtered wide-span cocones synchronize the finitely many witnesses, and separation gives equality at one stage over the whole qcqs object. For surjectivity, move the finitely many local lifts to a common stage and synchronize equality over all the finitely many qcqs pullbacks. Glue there. Filteredness supplies an index even when the cover is empty. The resulting two representative assertions give a colimit cocone after section evaluation and the required bijective canonical comparison.

Apply the site-level theorem that internal Hom from a locally finitely presented module preserves filtered colimits. Forgetting module sheaves to abelian sheaves preserves colimits by moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful. Section evaluation at the terminal pro-etale object preserves the resulting filtered colimit by the preceding section calculation.

Identify global Hom naturally with sections of internal Hom at the terminal object. Send a global morphism to its restriction on the terminal slice. Recover a global morphism from such a section by evaluating at each object's canonical terminal arrow; naturality and uniqueness of terminal arrows verify both inverse identities. Transport colimit preservation across this natural isomorphism. Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff gives exactly the stated common-stage equality using postcomposition by the original colimit coprojections.
